stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: Make it ours, with a name.

stations.title: morning.txt
stations.text: Three long commands only Idris can read.

captions: Idris is away next week, and Hesper must run the morning check on the press-room computer.
The note holds three long commands only Idris can read, and the screen is small.
You add a setting a flag overrides, colour only for people, and a name.
Now Hesper types orders check and reads it, and the note says orders, three times.
From three long commands to a tool of the shop's own, in five issues.
